label: Cluster assessment of esse-root and quarta-via leaves: reception, causal power, degrees
summary: Issue #1751 bottom-out walk, family F: the fourteen open leaves that remain unassessed when the GOD_4 routes other than the prima via are expanded (esse-root routes 3367bf93 and fc46b7f9, fixed-esse bundle c98328f1, quarta-via routes 5d2b7c6e, 678ff65f and 661ce61d). Drafted on main df4909cb025d2e53fee6071a32defe9cf2721284. Read: the Solutions of every consumer (nothingElseReachesPrimary, approachToPrimaryFromDegreeMeasure, gradesAtBeingFromApproach, attributionOrderGenusPrincipleAtBeing, identityAscentFromReception, esseCauseGroundViaDistinctDependence, existingInActAtFromEleaticPower, inhabitedFromFloorActivity, thoughtIsExerciseFromOpining, maximeEnsCausesAllMaximal) and of the route theorems godOfRootAtBeing, maximumEqualsRoot and maximumExistsOfExistingRoot; the materialized pinned passages AQUINAS-ST-I-Q7-A1, -Q7-A2, -Q25-A1, -Q3-A5 and -Q44-A1; dossier, brief and semantics for all fourteen and semantics for nine consumers; the accepted-but-unmerged family assessments of PRs #1768, #1769, #1772, #1773 and #1776. Route use: c8002f3e applies 29e71e43 and 7de89edb at every x other than the supplied primary p and 1304b462 and e2462fa8 at p only; bcc00761 applies 38cf20d9, 331f4751 and e462cf2f at esse; the esse-root routes apply 0436de86 at the root and cb1cdea9 at the pair (maximum, root), so 2068f91c and 82eeeb3c are consumed there. Every leaf except 2068f91c has a registered bypass on all six routes; all four derivations of cb1cdea9 contain 2068f91c. Scratch-checked, unregistered: the reception quartet is conservative over 'creatures have limited esse, the primary does not'; the Eleatic pair is conservative over adf07168; the calibration pair is conservative over the order-by-approach clause; and the approach package makes its supplied primary StrictlyGreatestIn (MAXIME_3), so this support option adds no independent warrant for the existence of a maximum. Lane D's role/measure fork has a monadic analogue here but yields no inconsistency (the batch witness satisfies all six premises of c8002f3e). End states: derivable e462cf2f (from a9622441's verum conjunct and 5a948c37), fad8af3e (from e462cf2f and e4e6b0cd, or from an in-act being, e4e6b0cd and excluded middle), ae68972c (from adf07168 and the act-to-active-principle direction that q.25 a.1 co. uses for God; unregistered reading) and 82eeeb3c (from 4ccb319f and the unregistered CONCRETE_AND_ABSTRACT_6 profile dictionary); defended 29e71e43, 7de89edb, 1304b462 (q.7 a.1-2 readings, with q.7 a.2 ad 1 read here), 0a7896e7 (stated, q.25 a.1), and the representation postulates 331f4751 and 38cf20d9; open e2462fa8 (missing identity-bearer bridge at the supplied primary), 54b0131b (immanent action), c8394eaf (phantasia in DEF-OPINING; the route's instance survives) and 2068f91c (alignment of the CausesIn and D modes). Sense findings: 82eeeb3c links CONCRETE_AND_ABSTRACT_6 while its paraphrase, doc comment and only supporting relation gloss causal capacity (CONCRETE_AND_ABSTRACT_5); the monadic limitation fork is unrecorded; the 0a7896e7 and ae68972c power links differ; cc2ae5ba's thought-episode/opining passage is carried by a082d5be, undeclared as a sense bridge. Objections: kept 4, restated 6, no substantive objection identified 6. No theorem, Challenge, claim, statement, definition, relation, closure or formal status changed. No revision is declared.
blocker: Open, each with a named blocker. e2462fa8: missing identity-bearer bridge at p. The passage (q.7 a.1 co.) grounds non-reception in God's esse being subsistent, so the warrant transfers to p only if p's essence is its esse, and no route supplies that; supplying it directly would assume a central part of what the GOD_4 routes are to show. No derivation on file (candidate: the identity-bearer step of identityAscentFromReception from 6dfe01ab, 7fcfcee8 and 14325c83). 54b0131b: understanding is classed as an action that remains in the agent (relation 946bd61a), and Ontic.Causes needs a candidate individual as effect; the Lean does not require y distinct from b, so the blocker is whether Causes admits the agent's own perfection (y := b), and the paraphrase's 'of another' is not in the Lean type; dispensable through the capacity sibling 8061edec. c8394eaf: DEF-OPINING includes having it appear that p, so imaginings fall under it; kept as a scope objection on a faculty psychology placing imagination in sense; the route's questioning episode survives. 2068f91c: CausesIn at esse is tenseless and mode-unspecified and D's originating/sustaining fork is open (#1626); with an originating cause and sustaining D the parent-child case is a counterexample; it is jointly warranted with a8298fbd, or its stronger, non-distinct sibling 2e248016, which meets the same origin counterexample, only on the sustaining reading, of the originating/sustaining pair considered (bridge ce55210c, open). It has no bypass among registered derivations; cb1cdea9's direct option (analyst bridge) remains. Next test: register the sustaining sibling of 2068f91c, derive the route instance at (maximum, root) from it and ce55210c, and Lean-check the parent-child interpretation against every premise but ce55210c.

current_assessment.scope: Family F of the #1751 bottom-out walk: the fourteen open leaves reached by expanding the esse-root routes 3367bf93 and fc46b7f9, the fixed-esse bundle c98328f1 and the quarta-via routes 5d2b7c6e, 678ff65f and 661ce61d to GOD_4 8626f8a5, in reception and limitation of esse, causal power and degrees of being. Neighbouring statements with their own assessments (56f68b40, 0436de86, adf07168, cb1cdea9, e4e6b0cd, da09703b, a8298fbd, d9fad785 and the other families' leaves) are used, not reassessed.
current_assessment.assessment: Under the fixed meanings (monadic EsseLimited and EsseReceivedIn with open real constitution; CREATURE_1; the approach order with supplied primary p, near and value; MoreIn at esse read analogically; MAXIME_1 weak maximality; causal power as capacity; ExistsAt as existence in re; tenseless, mode-unspecified CausesIn at esse; counterfactual D with its originating/sustaining fork open; DEF-OPINING including appearing) the fourteen end as follows. Derivable, 4: e462cf2f from the verum conjunct of a9622441 and the comparative conjunct of 5a948c37 at esse; fad8af3e from e462cf2f and e4e6b0cd, or from an in-act being, e4e6b0cd and excluded middle; ae68972c from adf07168 on its direct option and the act-to-active-principle direction that q.25 a.1 co. itself uses for God (unregistered, supported reading); 82eeeb3c from 4ccb319f and the unregistered CONCRETE_AND_ABSTRACT_6 profile dictionary. Defended, 6: 29e71e43 (q.7 a.2 co. with ad 1, moderate to strong), 7de89edb and 1304b462 (q.7 a.1-2 readings; near-analytic on the role reading of limitation, substantive on the measure reading), 0a7896e7 (stated, q.25 a.1 co., strong), and the representation postulates 331f4751 and 38cf20d9, conservative over the order-by-approach clause. 29e71e43 is also derivable from da72ae93 on its direct option, but da72ae93 has no recorded warrant beyond the same q.7 a.2 generalization, so that adds no independent warrant and the end state stays P. Open, 4: e2462fa8 (missing identity-bearer bridge at the supplied primary: q.7 a.1 grounds non-reception in subsistent esse), 54b0131b (immanent action; the effect slot needs a candidate individual), c8394eaf (phantasia; the route's questioning episode survives) and 2068f91c (mode alignment; strong only on the aligned sustaining reading). Thirteen of the fourteen are dispensable on all six routes; 2068f91c is in every registered derivation of cb1cdea9, and through 2247dfc4 and dbf76ba6 also in non-trapping 5c898d24 (only 9f2b1c6c avoids it). The reception and approach leaves add no independent warrant for the existence of a maximum: for their supplied primary they entail strict greatestness (scratch-checked). The existence of a maximum rests on a being in act at esse together with e4e6b0cd. Outside family F, e4e6b0cd has two options: 6c27657f (through 5584b295), or 7dfa068a with c11369aa and excluded middle (through f52deeb7). Otherwise it rests on the supplied primary. Universal causal reach (da09703b) rests separately on d9fad785 (f4abae1b), cffad050 (f4df2153), 3eb63770 with 3e2fc282 (5106f118), or 2336e5b4 with 6f4824c9 (f35f4105). Route level: the esse-root routes give moderate support for an actual ungrounded root (conditional on the non-trapping and priority inputs, not assessed here) and weak to moderate support for GOD_4; their binding constraint is identifying the maximum with the root, through the genus principle's universal causal reach (lane D, #1772) and cb1cdea9, whose 2068f91c and a8298fbd (or 2e248016) are jointly warranted only on the sustaining reading of CausesIn and D, of the originating/sustaining pair considered (lane B, #1769); through 5c898d24 the same dependency reaches the root input unless non-trapping is taken through 9f2b1c6c. Conditional on the other lanes' assessments in PRs #1769, #1772, #1773 and #1776, which are not merged. Kept objections 4 (immanent action; phantasia, conditional; origin without sustaining dependence, conditional; degree-of-being deniers, sense-relative); restated 6; no substantive objection identified 6. Countermodels are facts about single interpretations. Nothing is established or defeated.
current_assessment.next_test: Register the sustaining sibling of 2068f91c (antecedent SustainsBeing, CAUSE_OF_BEING_2, with c distinct from x; consequent D on its sustaining reading) and derive the esse-root routes' instance at (maximum, root) from it and the registered bridge ce55210c. Then Lean-check whether the parent-child interpretation (an originating giver, the effect persisting after it ceases) satisfies every premise except ce55210c. If the composition needs a further law from SustainsBeing to the counterfactual D, that law is the exact open input of the identification step. Otherwise the step costs exactly ce55210c's warrant (366a6ea3: da72ae93, 40a97664, d7f5a528; or 835330d4: 23e04ae5). The primary discriminating comparison is ce55210c (sustaining causation of being, in the temporal-history framework of CAUSE_OF_BEING_2) against existential inertia; the first step likely needs a law from SustainsBeing to the counterfactual D. Second: register e2462fa8's identity-bearer derivation from 6dfe01ab, 7fcfcee8 and 14325c83. Third: register the derivations of e462cf2f and fad8af3e.
